field_checklists.scoring: completeness_score = present_usable_fields / relevant_field_set (rounded to 4 decimals). Presence uses the same ListingData / ListingPropertyHighlights / SharedLivingMatchTokens helpers the UI and match engine consume.

detail_page_story.reason: Story builders gate sections on isNotEmpty; description uses placeholder "No description provided." when empty; host uses "Your host" fallback.
detail_page_story.title: Family-friendly spare room · Lucan

detail_page_story.reason: IP story gates highlights + preference on isNotEmpty; commute shrinks when empty

synthetic_empty_maps.reason: Fully empty maps produce empty section cell lists (hidden) or legacy 4-cell platform fallbacks — no blank labels

empty_data_handling.blank_sections: Avoided for highlight grids — listing_detail_page_layout wraps ROOM SNAPSHOT / HOUSEHOLD SNAPSHOT / CULTURE / PROPERTY DETAILS / PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS / preference insight in `if (cells.isNotEmpty)`.
empty_data_handling.empty_chips: PropertyCard._CardMatchChips returns SizedBox.shrink() when no chip labels resolve; chips only appended when labels non-null/non-empty.
empty_data_handling.broken_layouts: Fixed-height chip row still reserved on cards (chipsHeight) even when shrink — layout gap only, not broken. Detail page Column collapses hidden sections.
empty_data_handling.placeholder_text: Description: "No description provided." Host: "Your host". Title ListingData fallback: "Untitled listing". Card location can fallback toward Dublin area copy.
empty_data_handling.missing_explanations: Preference insight card omitted when explanation list empty — expected for sparse listings / hard-filter failures.
empty_data_handling.rendering_errors: Helpers return empty lists rather than throwing on missing fields. Legacy ListingPropertyHighlights.gridCells fills 4 platform fallbacks.
